The Information Systems Analyst 4 serves as a senior analyst and operational lead within End Point Support (EPS). The position performs advanced business and systems analysis, leads operational workstreams, develops business cases and reporting methodologies, and coordinates cross-functional initiatives affecting endpoint lifecycle management, asset utilization, facilities implementation readiness, printer optimization, IT service management, and customer experience.
20% - Endpoint Asset Optimization and Lifecycle Management

Operating under general direction of the End Point Support Manager, the incumbent independently evaluates complex operational data, identifies risks and opportunities, develops recommendations, and leads implementation activities. The role translates departmental strategy into executable plans, standards, dashboards, governance practices, and measurable outcomes. The incumbent regularly prepares decision-support materials for leadership and builds partnerships across technical, operational, financial, and business functions.
20% - Operational Project Leadership and Implementation
15% - Facilities Implementation Group (FIG) and Operational Readiness
10% - Business Process Improvement and ITSM Analytics
15% - Endpoint Lifecycle, Fleet Optimization, and Vendor Coordination
10% - Stakeholder Engagement, Communication, and Change Enablement
10% - Strategic Analysis, Standards, and Operational Planning
Self-motivated person who can work independently and as part of a team.
Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, operational leaders, customers, vendors, and senior management.
Knowledge of procurement, financial analysis, vendor management, change management, and cost-avoidance methodologies.
Advanced knowledge of information systems analysis, business process analysis, requirements development, operational planning, and service-delivery improvement.
Advanced project leadership, facilitation, risk management, stakeholder engagement, and change-enablement skills.
Working knowledge of endpoint technologies, hardware lifecycle practices, inventory and asset management, deployment operations, and support models.
Advanced written and verbal communication skills tailored to executives, technical teams, vendors, and customers.
Ability to analyze complex data sets, identify trends, develop dashboards and forecasts, and translate findings into defensible business recommendations.
Ability to develop business cases, cost-benefit analyses, governance practices, standards, procedures, metrics, and executive decision materials.
Strong written and verbal communication skills tailored to executives, technical teams, vendors, and customers.
Demonstrated judgment, organization, political acumen, customer orientation, and ability to lead multiple complex priorities in a high-impact environment.
Ability to work within the strict deadlines and within the specific time and budget requirements.
In-depth knowledge of various areas of IT. Broad knowledge of the IT environment.
